additional_info.subject: RE: ID0466690-DC/Si-D/CZ-[Y2 / S6 313724839009] Valina Payment Terminal Error CRM:02681001197
additional_info.body:
Hello Francisco,
This terminal on the charger
313724839009
never worked before. It has this error since the charger has been first switched on on-site.
Regarding the previous case where the terminal has the same issue and the same Error on the display, we did the exchange but the commissioning was not possible due to different problems that we couldn’t find the root of the cause. But the terminal itself it booted correctly and there was a possibility of the settings. But due to maybe wrong settings of the IP addresses of the server it was not possible to pair it with Terminal ID. Now the status of the previous case (ID0412734) is, that the customer EON Drive Czech Republic is waiting for some support from Valina to step further in the case because we have no idea what to do next. I believe this is some kind of internal problem and need to be solved by Valina.
Nevertheless, I think this new case is solvable only by exchanging the terminal unit since there is no possibility to do anything else on-site.
My colleague who commissioned two Sicharge-Ds last week told me he also had the same issue with one of those two terminals but I am not sure if he already raised a ticket about that charger.
I was not there on-site with him and now he is on holiday.
Thank you very much
BR Tomas
